parts:
Hi Rene,
the error means that you specified the columns wrongly. 
It seems that the station column is missing in the record table. Also, the second column has no column name. Is it output straight from recordTableIndividual() or was it manipulated with Excel or such? I'd suggest to rerun recordTableIndividual() to be on the safe side.
Jürgen

Hi Rene,
it works for me. I only adjusted the argument recordDateTimeFormat. It was set incorrectly, so I fixed it and simplified it by using the format required for lubridate.
I could not replicate your error:
c(speciesCol, recordDateTimeCol, stationCol, individualCol) %in%  .... are not all TRUE

Here's the code I used.

library(camtrapR)


wd <- "C:/..."    # folder containing the csvs


IndRT <- read.csv(file.path(wd, "RT_Davies_Feb18_Individuals.csv"))
dat   <- read.csv(file.path(wd, "DaviesCk_Feb18_CT.csv"))


camop_problem <- cameraOperation(dat,
                                 setupCol = "Date_set",
                                 retrievalCol = "Date_retrieved",
                                 dateFormat = "dmy")

secr_dh <- spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = IndRT,
                                   output = "count",
                                   camOp = camop_problem,
                                   CTtable = dat,
                                   stationCol = "Station",
                                   speciesCol = "Species",
                                   species = "V. varius",
                                   Xcol = "lon",
                                   Ycol = "lat",
                                   individualCol = "Individual",
                                   recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
recordDateTimeFormat =  "ymd HMS",

occasionLength = 1, # occasion length in days
                                   occasionStartTime = 6,
                                   day1 = "station",
                                   includeEffort = TRUE,
                                   timeZone = "Australia/Brisbane",
                                   makeRMarkInput = TRUE)
